notes: Running head ॥ अथर्ववेदे २ । ४-६ ॥, printed page १६ in the outer (left) margin. Accent policy: superscript stroke = U+0951, subscript line = U+0952, assigned to the akṣara directly above/below the mark. Mark positions were located mechanically (connected-component detection in the zones above the headline and below the baseline) and then attributed by eye, so accent PLACEMENT is best-effort; the akṣara sequence is the primary reading.
text_devanagari: श॒णश्च॑ मा जङ्गि॒डश्च॒ विष्क॑न्धाद॒भि र॑क्षताम् । अर॑ण्याद॒न्य आभृ॑तः कृ॒ष्या अ॒न्यो रसे॑भ्यः ॥ ५ ॥
कृ॒त्या॒दू॑षि॒रयं॒ मणिरथो॑ अराति॒दू॑षिः । अथो॒ सह॑स्वां जङ्गि॒डः प्र ण॒ आयूंषि तारिषत् ॥ ६ ॥

structural_marker: sūkta-opening numeral ॥ ५ ॥ printed in the left (outer) margin of this line
text_devanagari: इन्द्र॑ जुष॒स्व प्र व॒हा॒ या॑हि॒ शू॒र हरि॑भ्याम् । पिबा॑ सु॒तस्य॑ म॒तेरि॒ह मधोश्चका॒नश्चारु॒र्मदा॑य ॥ १ ॥

notes: After स्व the page prints the Devanagari digit १ (kampa / independent-svarita marker) carrying a vertical stroke above and a horizontal line below; both marks are transcribed on the digit.
text_devanagari: इन्द्र॑ ज॒ठ॑रं॒ नव्यो न पृणस्व॒ मधो॑र्दिवो॒ न । अ॒स्य सुतस्य॒ स्व॒१॒॑र्नोप॑ त्वा॒ मदाः॑ सुवाचो॑ अगुः ॥ २ ॥

notes: Fount note: in this 1856 Berlin fount च and त्र are closely similar at the resolution of this scan (4000 px wide). Readings of these two letters on this leaf were made on the presence or absence of a descending ्र hook and carry a residual risk. The akṣara between वृ and ं could not be decided between च and त्र and is left as [?]; it is visually indistinguishable here from the च of चकार printed two lines below and from the letter read as त्र elsewhere on the page.
text_devanagari: इन्द्र॑स्तु॒रा॒षाणिम॒चो वृ[?]ं॒ यो ज॒घान॑ य॒तीर्न । बि॒भेद॑ ब॒लं भृ॒गुर्न स॑सहे॒ शत्रू॒न्म॒दे सो॑मस्य ॥ ३ ॥

notes: First hemistich is set as an over-long line running into both margins.
text_devanagari: आ त्वा॑ वि॒शन्तु सु॒ता॑स॒ इन्द्र॑ पृ॒णस्व॑ कु॒क्षी वि॒ढिढ॒ श॑क्र धि॒येह्या नः॑ । श्रुधी ह॒वं॒ गिरो॑ मे जुष॒स्वेन्द्र॑ स्व॒युग्भि॒र्मत्स्वे॒ह म॒हे र॑णाय ॥ ४ ॥
इ॒न्द्र॑स्य॒ नु प्र वो॑चं॒ वीर्याणि॒ यानि॑ च॒कार॑ प्रथ॒मानि॑ व॒ज्री । अह॒न्नहि॒मन्वप॒स्तत॑र्द॒ प्र व॒क्षणा॑ अभिन॒त्पर्व॑तानाम् ॥ ५ ॥
अह॒न्नहिं॒ पर्वते शिश्रिया॒णं त्वष्टा॑स्मै वज्रं॑ स्व॒र्यं॑ ततक्ष । वा॒श्रा इ॑व धे॒नवः॒ स्यन्द॑माना॒ अञ्जः॑ समु॒द्रमव॑ जग्मुरापः॑ ॥ ६ ॥

notes: Fount note: in this 1856 Berlin fount च and त्र are closely similar at the resolution of this scan (4000 px wide). Readings of these two letters on this leaf were made on the presence or absence of a descending ्र hook and carry a residual risk. The first akṣara of [?]िक॑द्रुकेषु could not be decided between च and त्र and is left as [?].
structural_marker: ॥ प्रथमो ऽनुवाकः ॥ — anuvāka colophon printed centred on its own line after this mantra
text_devanagari: वृ॒षा॒य॒माणो॑ अवृणीत॒ सोमं॒ [?]िक॑द्रुकेष्वपिब॒त्सुत॑स्य । आ॒ साय॑कं म॒घवा॑द॒त्त व॒ज्रमह॑न्नेनं प्रथ॒मजाम॑हीनाम् ॥ ७ ॥

structural_marker: sūkta-opening numeral ॥ ६ ॥ printed in the left (outer) margin of this line
text_devanagari: समा॑स्त्वाग्न ऋ॒तवो॑ वर्धयन्तु संवत्स॒रा ऋ॒ष॑यो॒ यानि॑ सत्या॒ । सं दि॒व्येन॑ दीदिहि॒ रोच॒नेन॒ विश्वा॒ आ भा॑हि॒ प्र॒दिश॒श्च॒त॑स्रः ॥ १ ॥
सं चे॑ध्यस्वा॑ग्ने॒ प्र च॑ वर्धये॒ममुच्च॑ तिष्ठ म॒हते सौ॑भगाय । मा ते॑ रिष॒न्नुपस॒त्तारो॑ अग्ने॒ ब्रह्माण॒स्ते य॒शसः॑ सन्तु मान्ये ॥ २ ॥

notes: This mantra is split across the leaf boundary: its first hemistich is the last line of leaf n30 (printed page 16) and its second hemistich is the first line of leaf n31 (printed page 17). It is recorded once, on the leaf where it begins.
text_devanagari: त्वाम॑ग्ने वृ॒णते ब्राह्म॒णा इ॒मे शि॒वो अ॑ग्ने सं॒वर॑णे भवा नः । स॒प॒त्न॒हा॒ग्ने॑ अभिमाति॒जिद्भ॑व॒ स्वे गये॑ जागृ॒ह्यप्र॑युच्छन् ॥ ३ ॥
